title: Reboot into BIOS/UEFI setup
summary: Restart your computer and enter the BIOS or UEFI firmware settings menu. This is useful for changing boot order or hardware settings.

steps.explain: This command reboots the system and instructs the firmware to enter the setup menu on the next boot.

rollback.explain: There is no command to cancel a reboot once initiated. Save your work before running this.

warnings: All unsaved work will be lost.
